title: Tommee Tippee FlexiPen Thermometer for Underarm or Under Tongue $2.50 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Tommee Tippee FlexiPen Thermometer for Underarm or Under Tongue $2.50 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU

[PainToad] This is dog shit. I threw it out.
This one much better https://www.chemistwarehouse.com.au/buy/68659/vicks-insight-…
[totororo] For 10x the price it better be much better
[Scoobth] The vicks one is impossible to find replacement batteries for, making it a throw away device.
it works, but is not good value!
[recession1] Well done to anyone who bought this at $2.50.
For anyone considering paying more than that, our experience is that it regularly takes 20-30 seconds to register a reading which is way too slow when you’re holding down a wriggling child. I wouldn’t recommend it at all at anywhere near full price.
[PainToad] And randomly turn off while waiting. It makes me angry this thing is sold. It's that bad.
[PainToad] Probably people cancelling their orders after reading how shirt this thing is.
[gakko] Don't do it to yourself. Painful getting an accurate reading imo. Buy an ear thermometer if you can afford
[EBC] I agree. Went through like 4 different ones for underarm (this one included) before just biting the bullet and buying the braun thermoscan 7+.
Just not accurate enough or fast enough for a squirmy child.
